name: SMC CHOCH + FVG Entry
description: ICT/SMC top-down entry strategy: price comes to a Point-of-Interest (FVG or liquidity sweep zone), a Change of Character (CHOCH) confirms the reversal, and a fresh FVG provides the entry zone. EMA 50/200 and ms_trend establish the higher-timeframe bias; displacement confirms impulse quality. Targets external liquidity (swing H/L, PDH/PDL).
hypothesis: Price only expands after reaching a higher-timeframe POI (FVG or sweep zone). A CHOCH at that POI signals the delivery direction. The FVG created by the CHOCH impulse is the highest-probability entry zone. ML learns which combinations of ms_choch_bull/bear, fvg_bull/bear_confirmed, ms_trend, displacement, and proximity to PDH/PDL produce the strongest edges.
expected_outcome: ms_choch_bull/bear and fvg_bull/bear_dist selected as top features. Higher win rate when ms_trend aligns with CHOCH direction and displacement is present. Edge primarily during London and New York kill zones.
